description: Read files back from a domain's Secure Static Hosting, so you can change a page without rebuilding it: read index.html, edit only what the user asked (e.g. the opening hours), show them the change, then publish it with deploy_site. Text files come back as `text` (the exact source, HTML and all, unlike fetching the live page), others as base64 `content`. Up to 20 paths per call; list_hosting_files shows what is there.

domain.description: Domain whose hosting files to read.

name: read_hosting_file
title: Read Hosting File
